comment: The narrator's tone depends on your Bond with them: Rival or worse is sarcastic, Stranger is dry, Acquaintance and up is warmer. Keys pick situations; tiers fall back to 'dry'.

sarcastic: Five more waves. You're either very good or very stubborn.
The Rift is keeping score. So am I. Mine is meaner.
dry: Another five waves. The Rift doesn't get tired. Noted.
The Rift rearranges itself. It's showing off.
warm: Five more. I'm genuinely impressed, and I don't say that.
You're getting the hang of this place. Careful, it notices.
Rest a second. You've earned it.

sarcastic: Bold strategy, saying that out loud.
And THAT is why we practice in the mirror.
I'd tell you to be careful, but you're not going to listen, so.
dry: That is not what you said. It is, however, what they heard.
Communication: an ancient art you have not mastered.
Somewhere between your mouth and their ears, the sentence took a wrong turn.
warm: Oof. You meant well. They didn't hear 'well'.
Not your fault. Mostly. Try again tomorrow.
Words are hard. You're getting there.

sarcastic: Huh. Look at you, being a person.
dry: That went well. Note it for later.
warm: See? People like you. Some of them. This one.

dry: That could have gone better. It could also have gone worse. Barely.
warm: Not every line lands. That one really didn't.

sarcastic: Keep being like this. See where it gets you. (Somewhere dark, small and collapsing.)
Some people panic under pressure. Some people CAUSE the pressure. Guess which one you are.
dry: People who panic tend to remember who stood next to them. And who didn't.
warm: Whatever happens tonight, she'll remember who was kind to her.
Pressure does strange things to people. Be the steady one.

sarcastic: There's a gap behind the deli. You'd see it if you looked. You never look.
Ever notice Earth Science predicts the weather down there too? No? Of course not.
dry: The alley behind the deli is worth a look, if your eyes are sharp enough.
Earth Science class has opinions about tonight's weather. Listen to them.
warm: Psst: the alley behind Gary's. Sharp eyes, PER 7.
The weather station in the Earth Science room tells you what tonight will be like.

dry: You found me. Most people don't look.
I'm the voice. You're the protagonist. Allegedly.
warm: There you are. I was narrating to nobody.
Hey, you. Sit. The woods are listening anyway.
